senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. עָבָה)to swell. Y. B. Kam. VIII, beg. 6ᵇ אם כוייו … וצָבַת if one burnt a person with a heated spit on the palm of his hand, and it swelled; ib. על ראשו וצבת, (read וצבה) a. e.—[Ber. 6ᵇ לִצְבּוֹת Ar., v. צָבַת.]

<cite ref="R00032">same</cite>. Y. Sot. V, beg. 20ᵃ (line 20) <he>מים מגולין שתה ונ׳</he> (ed. Krot. <he>שתת ונצבית</he>, corr. acc.) he drank uncovered water (poisoned by a serpent) and his belly was swollen.

units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17">Lev. R. s. 17</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 808:3">Yalk. Ps. 808</cite> [read:] <he>ולא צִבִּיתִים</he>, v. <cite ref="P00295"><he>עוֹנָה</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: to cause the appearance of being swollen.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 4:14">Tosef. Peah IV, 14</cite> <he>המְצַבֶּה את כריסו</he> he that feigns a swollen belly; Y. ib. VIII, 21ᵇ top <he>המְצַבֵּא</he>; <cite ref="Ketubot 68a:3">Keth. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>המצב׳ את בטנו</he>.
